title: Transformers and attention
transcript: Welcome to AI Simplified. In this video we look at transformers and attention. Before we start, remember what we covered about convolutional neural networks. Convolutional neural networks, or CNNs, are neural networks designed for images. Transformers replaced recurrent neural networks for most language tasks because they train in parallel. In simple words, self attention computes queries, keys and values with matrix multiplication. Attention lets every word in a sentence look at every other word and decide what is relevant. Transformers are neural networks built around the attention mechanism. In simple words, word embeddings represent words as vectors so that similar words are close together. Positional encoding tells the transformer the order of the words. So that is a quick summary of transformers and attention. Subscribe for the next part of the deep learning series.
